lines.say: Twelve-hour shift, then two hours of revision? That plan was never going to work.
You get home, you skip it, and by Friday the whole week is behind.
Offload plans around your shifts, lectures and placements, once they're in your Google Calendar.
It puts every session in the free time that's actually left.
Miss one, and it moves the work into your free time, and tells you what moved.
Offload. A study system that adapts when real life happens.
